chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check.name: chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check
chat_rooms_kind_cuencada_check.value: ("kind" = 'global' and "cuencada_id" is null and "event_id" is null) or ("kind" = 'cuencada' and "cuencada_id" is not null and "event_id" is null) or ("kind" = 'event' and "event_id" is not null and "cuencada_id" is null)

cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check.name: cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check
cuencada_itinerary_items_tags_check.value: cardinality("tags") <= 6 and array_position("tags", null) is null

cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_chec.name: cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_check
cuencada_itinerary_items_time_order_chec.value: "start_time" is null or "end_time" is null or "end_time" > "start_time"

cuencadas_dates_check.name: cuencadas_dates_check
cuencadas_dates_check.value: ("starts_at" is null and "ends_at" is null) or ("starts_at" is not null and "ends_at" is not null and "ends_at" > "starts_at")

events_dates_check.name: events_dates_check
events_dates_check.value: ("starts_at" is null and "ends_at" is null) or ("starts_at" is not null and "ends_at" is not null and "ends_at" > "starts_at")

events_year_check.name: events_year_check
events_year_check.value: "starts_at" is null or "year" = extract(year from ("starts_at" at time zone "timezone"))::integer

events_cover_check.name: events_cover_check
events_cover_check.value: ("cover_key" is null) = ("cover_updated_at" is null) and ("cover_key" is null or "cover_key" ~ ('^events/' || "id"::text || '/cover/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}-1280[.]webp$'))

media_items_dimensions_check.name: media_items_dimensions_check
media_items_dimensions_check.value: ("width" is null or "width" > 0) and ("height" is null or "height" > 0) and ("duration_seconds" is null or "duration_seconds" >= 0)

media_items_storage_prefix_check.name: media_items_storage_prefix_check
media_items_storage_prefix_check.value: (("album_id" is null and "memory_album_id" is null) or "storage_prefix" is not null) and ("storage_prefix" is null or "storage_prefix" ~ '^(cuencadas/[0-9]{4}|events/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|memories/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$')

notifications_target_check.name: notifications_target_check
notifications_target_check.value: ("kind" in ('photo_tag_request', 'photo_commented', 'photo_liked') and "media_id" is not null and "event_id" is null and "proposal_id" is null) or ("kind" = 'event_added' and "event_id" is not null and "media_id" is null and "proposal_id" is null) or ("kind" = 'tree_proposal_resolved' and "proposal_id" is not null and "media_id" is null and "event_id" is null)

notifications_dedupe_key_check.name: notifications_dedupe_key_check
notifications_dedupe_key_check.value: "dedupe_key" is null or char_length("dedupe_key") between 1 and 200

people_years_order_check.name: people_years_order_check
people_years_order_check.value: "birth_year" is null or "death_year" is null or "death_year" >= "birth_year"

people_birth_date_year_check.name: people_birth_date_year_check
people_birth_date_year_check.value: "birth_date" is null or ("birth_year" is not null and extract(year from "birth_date") = "birth_year")

people_death_date_year_check.name: people_death_date_year_check
people_death_date_year_check.value: "death_date" is null or ("death_year" is not null and extract(year from "death_date") = "death_year")

people_dates_order_check.name: people_dates_order_check
people_dates_order_check.value: "birth_date" is null or "death_date" is null or "death_date" >= "birth_date"

people_photo_check.name: people_photo_check
people_photo_check.value: "photo_key" is null or "photo_updated_at" is not null

person_revisions_snapshots_check.name: person_revisions_snapshots_check
person_revisions_snapshots_check.value: ("before" is null or (jsonb_typeof("before") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("before" -> 'personId'), '') = 'string')) and ("after" is null or (jsonb_typeof("after") = 'object' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("after" -> 'personId'), '') = 'string'))

person_revisions_has_snapshot_check.name: person_revisions_has_snapshot_check
person_revisions_has_snapshot_check.value: "before" is not null or "after" is not null

tree_link_proposals_relation_check.name: tree_link_proposals_relation_check
tree_link_proposals_relation_check.value: ("kind" = 'relate') = ("relation" is not null) and ("relation" is null or "relation" in ('parent_of', 'partner_of'))

tree_link_proposals_pending_people_check.name: tree_link_proposals_pending_people_check
tree_link_proposals_pending_people_check.value: "status" <> 'pending' or ("from_person_id" is not null and "to_person_id" is not null)

profiles_contact_visibility_check.name: profiles_contact_visibility_check
profiles_contact_visibility_check.value: jsonb_typeof("contact_visibility") = 'object' and ("contact_visibility" - array['whatsapp', 'instagram', 'facebook', 'tiktok', 'linkedin', 'github', 'website']::text[]) = '{}'::jsonb and not jsonb_path_exists("contact_visibility", '$.* ? (@.type() != "boolean")')

cuencada_rsvps_dates_check.name: cuencada_rsvps_dates_check
cuencada_rsvps_dates_check.value: "arrival_date" is null or "departure_date" is null or "departure_date" >= "arrival_date"

media_comments_body_check.name: media_comments_body_check
media_comments_body_check.value: char_length("body") <= 1000 and (char_length(btrim("body")) >= 1 or ("deleted_at" is not null and "body" = ''))

media_comments_deleted_check.name: media_comments_deleted_check
media_comments_deleted_check.value: "deleted_by_user_id" is null or "deleted_at" is not null

media_tags_position_check.name: media_tags_position_check
media_tags_position_check.value: ("x" is null) = ("y" is null) and ("x" is null or ("x" between 0 and 1 and "y" between 0 and 1))
